assertions.claim: 52 pairs of strangers chatted about ten minutes and then judged whether flirting occurred
assertions.cn_span: 让 52 对陌生男女聊十来分钟再互相判断有没有在调情

assertions.claim: 'Not flirting' was judged fairly accurately while 'flirting' was barely detectable
assertions.cn_span: 「对方没在调情」判得比较准，「对方在调情」反而看不出来

assertions.claim: 261 people judging one-minute videos gave the same result
assertions.cn_span: 换成 261 个人看一分钟视频判断，结论一样

assertions.claim: Don't infer minds from expression and tone; look at observable behavior: who initiates, who arranges the next date, who follows up when you don't push
assertions.cn_span: 所以别从表情语气反推心思，看可观察的行为：谁主动发起、谁安排下一次、你不推进时对方跟不跟进

assertions.claim: Both research camps agree: inferring intent from subtle cues like expression and tone has low accuracy
assertions.cn_span: 从表情、语气这类细微线索反推对方心思，准确率很低

assertions.claim: Other research argues men don't overestimate women's sexual interest; women underreport in self-reports; whose judgments are more accurate is unsettled
assertions.cn_span: 另有研究认为男性并非高估了女性的性意图，而是女性在自陈时低报了，双方到底谁的判断更准仍无定论
